summary: ChargePoint filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Settlement Term Sheet resolving the Farooq Khan securities class action in the N.D. Cal. (No. 5:23-cv-06172-NW). The company will pay $11 million cash into escrow within 21 days of preliminary court approval, with a final settlement agreement and preliminary approval motion expected within 30 days. No wrongdoing is admitted; individual defendants, including former CEO Romano, former CFO Jackson, and former CCO Hughes, deny liability. This is litigation resolution, not a special situation; court approval and dismissal remain the watch items.
